versions.content: If the return value of the function Dem_J1939DcmClearDTC is E _OK or DEM _PENDING , the J1939 Diagnostic Communication Manager shall send a positive acknowledgement (PACK) by J1939Rm_SendAck with parameters ‘ackCode’ set to J1939RM_ACK_POSITIVE.
